evals.prompt: I finished the OAuth2 login work on feature/ABC-123_oauth-login and pushed my commits, can you open a PR for it?
assertions: Checks working tree status and current branch before proceeding, and confirms the branch is not main/master
Extracts ticket ID ABC-123 from the branch name and includes it in the generated PR title
Generates a conventional-commit-style title (type(scope): [ABC-123] description) under 72 chars
Every PR body bullet traces back to an actual commit or diff hunk from git log/git diff, not invented claims
Asks for user confirmation (y/n/e) before running git push and gh pr create
Does not invoke or reference any PreToolUse hook script, and does not silently run the project's full test suite as a side effect of gh pr create

evals.prompt: Open a draft PR targeting the develop branch for my current changes
assertions: Parses --base/-b to target develop instead of the repo default branch
Passes --draft to the gh pr create command because a draft PR was requested
Determines commits/diff via git log and git diff against origin/develop, not origin/main
Does not combine --reviewer/--assignee/--label flags with --web in the gh pr create call
Confirms with the user before pushing and creating the PR

evals.prompt: Create a pull request for this branch, we have a PR template in the repo so make sure it's used
assertions: Looks for .github/pull_request_template.md and fills it in without altering its structure
Falls back to the default Summary/Changes/Testing template only if no repo template file is found
Saves the generated body to a temp file (e.g. /tmp/pr-body-<timestamp>.md) before calling gh pr create --body-file
The gh pr create call in the final step reuses that same BODY_FILE variable rather than writing a second, different placeholder body
Shows a compact preview of the title and body and asks for confirmation before creating the PR
Pushes the branch with git push -u origin <branch> before invoking gh pr create

evals.prompt: This repo has GitHub Actions set up under .github/workflows/ci.yml, and I haven't run the tests locally yet. Can you open a PR for my branch?
assertions: Notices the repo has .github/workflows configured and tests were not verified locally this session
Suggests running the cc-arsenal:ci-local skill before confirming PR creation, rather than silently running a test suite itself
Does not block or auto-run tests as a hook side effect of gh pr create — the suggestion is a spoken recommendation, not an enforced gate
Still proceeds to ask for the normal y/n/e confirmation after the suggestion, it does not refuse to create the PR

evals.prompt: Create a PR for my current branch
assertions: Runs git status --porcelain as a precondition check before doing anything else, before any branch or diff analysis
The working tree has an uncommitted change (e.g. modified README.md); the agent stops and tells the user to commit or stash it instead of pushing a PR with an unclean state

No mutating git command (git checkout, git restore, git reset, git stash, or git clean) is run against the user's tracked files at any point in the transcript — the file's uncommitted change is still present and unmodified at the end of the run
Does not fabricate a PR title or body before preconditions are validated
Does not run git push or gh pr create — the workflow ends at the refusal, it does not silently 'fix' the dirty tree and continue

evals.prompt: I'm on main with a couple local commits nobody's pushed yet, open a PR for them
assertions: Runs git branch --show-current as a precondition check and detects the current branch is main
Refuses to open a PR from main/master and tells the user to check out a feature branch first, instead of proceeding
Does not create, switch to, or rename a branch on the user's behalf to route around the check — it reports and stops, it does not fix the precondition itself
Does not run git push or gh pr create for this branch
Does not fabricate a PR title or body before preconditions are validated
